html:
Question 1
?

Find the first four non-zero terms of the Maclaurin expansion of 11−x3.

a
11−x3=1+x3+2x6+3x9+⋯
b
11−x3=1+x3+x6+x9+⋯
c
11−x3=1+2x3+3x6+4x9+⋯
d
11−x3=1+x3+3x6+6x9+⋯
e
11−x3=1+3x3+6x6+9x9+⋯
Submit
